normal_use: Consult this profile for shared Qumus routing, pad reuse, marker reuse, layer grouping, clearance, and verification conventions. Do not read or infer geometry from archived sample designs unless the human explicitly supplies a reference layout for the current run.

mandatory_project_rules.drawn_gds_layer_policy: Draw only actual physical/electrical circuit geometry in GDS: imported alignment markers and pads, material flakes, contact metal, gate metal, routing metal, and explicitly required real keep-outs. Do not draw layer-map boxes, review frames, substrate/chip frames, scale bars, inset frames, legend swatches, explanatory labels, annotation-only layers, or process-session placeholder layers unless explicitly requested. Put layer meanings, clean-room order, checks, and palette information in result JSON/run notes.

review_palette_policy.alignment_marker: saturated pink/magenta outline, matching the imported alignmarker visual reference while staying distinct from contact metal
review_palette_policy.contact: distinct orange outline for contact metal
review_palette_policy.bond_pad: light blue outline/hatch-style display, matching the imported bond-pad visual reference
review_palette_policy.outer_routing: light blue outline/hatch-style display for outer routing metal, matching the bond-pad visual reference
review_palette_policy.other_device_layers: soft scientific-plot palette inspired by blue, amber, orange, pale teal, and green series
review_palette_policy.fill_policy: unfilled or transparent/outline display; avoid opaque filled-color geometry

mandatory_project_rules.bond_pad_touching_landing_scope: Only the short outer-routing landing/neck segment that directly touches or overlaps an imported 250 um x 250 um bond pad is required to be 50 um wide. Other outer-routing segments are not globally constrained to 50 um; size them by net width, clearance, congestion, and smooth fan-out needs. The pad-touching neck must extend at least 50 um into the pad, or twice the previous shallow depth, whichever is larger, and must terminate as a complete orthogonal rectangle/polygon with no missing corner, notch, chamfer, or diagonal bite.
mandatory_project_rules.synthetic_flake_shape_policy: Initial-design virtual/synthetic flake outlines must start from a quadrilateral base silhouette and then jag/perturb the edges irregularly. Do not use ellipses, noisy circles, simple rectangles, or regular polygons as flake silhouettes; real flake geometry comes only from candidate masks during real-flake adaptation.
mandatory_project_rules.feature_non_overlap_rule: Never let functionally distinct geometry unintentionally overlap. Newly drawn electrodes, gates, contacts, and routing metal must not overlap or intrude into the imported alignment-marker geometry or the imported bond-pad regions outside their intended landing necks, and metal on different, non-connected nets must not touch or overlap on the same layer. Overlap that is part of the intended stack (a layer covering the material below it, a designed contact/gate overlap, or an intentional handoff stitch) is expected and not a violation; only unintended collisions are errors. Run an explicit overlap check (a pya.Region boolean AND, or equivalent) between new device geometry and the imported alignment-marker/bond-pad regions before saving or verifying, and fix any unintended overlap.

universal_stack_and_contact_type_default.architecture: Every project device (ReSe2 transistor or graphene quantum Hall family) defaults to a two-hBN-layer architecture, one hBN above and one hBN below the active material, plus one graphite gate layer, unless approved guidance explicitly overrides the architecture.
universal_stack_and_contact_type_default.top_hbn_thickness_default_um: 10-30 nm, covering the whole active-material flake, for every device family unless explicitly overridden. Accept database hBN thickness bins 10-20 and 20-30 for this role.
universal_stack_and_contact_type_default.graphite_gate_thickness_default: Database category type_label='Gr' and thickness_label='manylayer', whichever side hosts the graphite gate (top graphite gate for the bottom-contact/ReSe2 family, bottom graphite gate for the edge-contact/graphene family). Do not require, infer, or filter on graphite thickness in nanometers.

bottom_hbn_thickness_by_contact_type.bottom_contact: 5-20 nm, for devices using bottom local/split metal gates plus bottom source/drain metal finger contacts (the ReSe2-style family).
bottom_hbn_thickness_by_contact_type.edge_contact: 35-40 nm, for devices using edge metal contacts to the active material (the graphene-style family); the extra thickness protects the bottom graphite gate while etching the contact edge.

contact_type_device_family_mapping.bottom_contact: aka 'bottom contact geometry'. Maps to the ReSe2-style family: Top Graphite Gate / Top hBN / active material / Source-Drain Contacts (bottom metal fingers) / Bottom hBN / Bottom Metal Contact-Gate Array.
contact_type_device_family_mapping.edge_contact: Maps to the graphene-style family: Top hBN / active material / Bottom hBN / Bottom Graphite Gate, with edge metal contacts (5 nm Cr / 60-65 nm Au unless overridden).

universal_stack_and_contact_type_default.simplified_input_policy: A short human request that only names the device/active material and its contact type is complete. Fill every omitted layer, thickness, and geometry detail from these universal defaults plus the matching device-family defaults instead of asking the human to restate them.

mandatory_project_rules.device_family_contact_spacing_rule: Use the contact landing spacing supplied by the active device-family skill or approved guidance. If no device-family spacing rule is supplied, keep contact landings electrically connected while preserving route-to-route and route-to-obstacle clearance.
mandatory_project_rules.graphite_pickup_top_hbn_access_rule: When a graphite pickup is required by the active device-family skill or approved guidance, keep the graphite landing and its metal pickup contact exposed for direct electrical contact. Dielectric coverage must not block the designed graphite-to-metal pickup overlap.

metal_layer_grouping_policy.inner_zone_definition: Use the exact inner routing zone coordinates supplied by the active device-family skill or approved guidance, such as inner_zone_bbox_um or inner_zone_corners_um. If none is supplied, derive a compact inner fan-out zone from the active device geometry and record its exact coordinates in the result.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.inner_contact_layer: Source/drain contact fingers, graphite contact landing geometry, and contact-net fan-out while inside the inner routing zone.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.inner_bottom_gate_layer: Local bottom gates and bottom-gate-net fan-out while inside the inner routing zone.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.outer_contact_layer: Large peripheral outer contacts and bond-pad lead segments outside the fixed inner routing zone.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.handoff_rule: Transition to the shared outer-contact layer only after crossing outside the fixed inner-zone rectangle.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.handoff_overlap_rule: At every inner-contact or inner-bottom-gate to shared outer-contact stitch, create intentional overlap at least 1.5 um x 1.5 um; cross-shaped stitches are allowed.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.same_layer_merge_rule: Merge same-layer polygonal geometry before saving/verifying using pya.Region(...).merged() or equivalent.
metal_layer_grouping_policy.vertical_overhang_rule: Straight central gate/contact segments must satisfy any vertical overhang rule supplied by the active device-family skill or approved guidance; otherwise record the chosen overhang in the result.

cleanroom_process_layer_policy.effective_layer_count_rule: Exclude review-only layers and process-order-only metadata/session layers from effective device layer counts.

review_geometry_policy.legend_annotation_inset_scale_bar: Do not draw review-only legend, annotation, inset, scale-bar, layer-map, substrate-frame, or process-placeholder geometry in GDS unless explicitly requested.
review_geometry_policy.verification: Run checks on physical/electrical circuit geometry only.

execution_policy.script_shape: Prefer one monolithic KLayout build script plus at most one bounded verification/refinement pass.
execution_policy.state_persistence: Do not rely on Python state persisting across KlayoutClaw execute_script calls.
execution_policy.review_screenshot_hierarchy_rule: Before any review screenshot, make the review/top design cell active and expand hierarchy. If child-cell instances are used for the core device, insets, or repeated geometry, either flatten/copy the real geometry into the screenshot review cell or set _layout_view.active_cellview().cell = review_cell and call _layout_view.max_hier() before KlayoutClaw screenshot. Screenshots that show only child-cell names, instance boxes, or labels are invalid even if recursive geometry checks pass.
execution_policy.stop_condition: Stop immediately after required GDS, screenshot, and result JSON exist and checks pass.

mandatory_project_rules.conflict_priority: Human guidance and mandatory_project_rules override inferred sample geometry.

2/0.narrow_rectangle_note: One observed local feature has bbox 0.451 x 0.474 um and aspect ratio about 1.1.

current_template_geometry.read_policy: read recursively from all template top cells

bond_pad_rule.implementation_note: Use imported alignmarker2 geometry as both the marker reference and bond-pad source. Route to the 21 imported nominal-250 um pad-like landing regions from alignmarker2.GDS; do not create additional bond pads unless the human explicitly overrides this rule.

project_layer_grouping_required.inner_zone_definition: Use the exact inner routing zone coordinates supplied by the active device-family skill or approved guidance, such as inner_zone_bbox_um or inner_zone_corners_um. If none is supplied, derive a compact inner fan-out zone from the active device geometry and record its exact coordinates in the result.
project_layer_grouping_required.inner_contact_layer: All source/drain contact fingers, graphite contact landing geometry, and contact-net fan-out while inside the inner routing zone.
project_layer_grouping_required.inner_bottom_gate_layer: All local bottom gates and bottom-gate-net fan-out while inside the inner routing zone.
project_layer_grouping_required.outer_contact_layer: Only the large peripheral outer contacts and bond-pad lead segments outside the fixed inner routing zone, after handoff outside the fixed rectangle.

lead_geometry_rules.style_from_sample: Use compact local fan-out near the active device and wider peripheral routing toward imported pad-like landing regions when compatible with the current device.
lead_geometry_rules.width_policy: Use narrow active-region contact/gate widths from approved guidance. Use 50 um width only for the short outer-routing landing/neck segment that directly touches or overlaps an imported bond pad unless explicitly overridden. Other outer-routing segments are not globally constrained to 50 um. The pad-touching neck must extend at least 50 um into the pad, or twice the previous shallow depth, whichever is larger, and must terminate with no missing corner, notch, chamfer, or diagonal bite.
lead_geometry_rules.outer_routing_width_policy: Outside the pad-touching landing/neck segment, choose outer-routing widths from net width, clearance, congestion, and fan-out geometry; do not force the full outer route to 50 um.
lead_geometry_rules.layer_grouping_policy: Keep inner fan-out on the device-family-specified inner contact/gate layers while inside the active inner routing zone. Transition to the shared outer-contact layer only after crossing outside that zone; use the shared layer for large peripheral contacts and bond-pad lead segments beyond that boundary. Every inner-contact or inner-gate to shared outer-contact stitch must intentionally overlap by at least 1.5 um x 1.5 um; cross-shaped stitches are allowed.
lead_geometry_rules.small_feature_reference: Layer 4/0 has repeated local features around 0.55 x 0.51 um; layer 2/0 has one sub-0.5um-width feature around 0.451 x 0.474 um.
lead_geometry_rules.route_shape_policy: Prefer explicit pya.Path or box routes with recorded widths and endpoints. Use KlayoutClaw auto_route only after placing temporary contact and pad pins and checking dry-run pairs.

pad_contact_rules.contact_to_lead: Leads must touch or intentionally overlap their assigned contact geometry; record overlap/tolerance in the result.
pad_contact_rules.pad_to_lead: Each independent contact/gate net should route to exactly one intended imported 250 x 250 um pad from alignmarker2.GDS unless the active device explicitly defines a shared bus. The short outer-routing landing/neck segment directly touching the pad should be 50 um wide unless explicitly overridden.
pad_contact_rules.net_mapping: Do not rely on positional ordering alone for dense devices. Use explicit contact-to-pad pair names or pin_pairs_override when using auto_route.

clearance_rules.route_to_route: Different non-connected wires/nets must not overlap, touch, coincide, or violate clearance. If no process-approved value is supplied, use 1.0 um as the provisional minimum for fan-out/routing wires and record it in result JSON. Keep explicitly specified 500 nm blank lateral gaps for the ReSe2 core bottom-metal strip array.
clearance_rules.route_to_obstacle: Treat active material, gate metals, dielectric exclusion zones, foreign flakes, and unrelated pads as obstacles unless the approved stack requires contact.
clearance_rules.same_layer_overlap: Allowed only for intentional junctions, contact landings, and pad landings. Merge same-layer polygonal geometry before saving/verifying using pya.Region(...).merged() or equivalent.

verification_gates.name: actual_circuit_layers_only
verification_gates.requirement: GDS contains only actual physical/electrical circuit geometry plus required imported alignment markers/pads; no layer-map boxes, review frames, substrate/chip frames, scale bars, inset frames, legend swatches, explanatory labels, annotation-only layers, or process-session placeholder layers unless explicitly requested.
verification_gates.method: Inspect GDS layer list and visual_legend actual_circuit_layer flags; reject standalone documentation/process-placeholder layers such as 2/0, 10/0, 200/0, 201/0, 900/90, 901/90, 903/90, 904/90, or 905/90 when they only hold review/process furniture.

verification_gates.name: synthetic_flake_shape
verification_gates.requirement: Initial-design virtual/synthetic flakes use quadrilateral-based outlines with irregular jagged/perturbed edges, not ellipses, noisy circles, simple rectangles, or regular polygons.
verification_gates.method: Inspect ideal_flake_geometry, polygon point construction, and screenshot silhouettes; verify real-flake adaptation uses candidate masks instead of synthetic placeholders.

verification_gates.name: left_graphite_contact_to_channel_spacing
verification_gates.requirement: For the project ReSe2 device, the vertical 3 um x 15 um left graphite contact landing is left of the ReSe2/channel outline, with 15-20 um horizontal gap from the landing's right edge to the leftmost channel boundary and never less than 15 um unless explicitly overridden.
verification_gates.method: Measure the x distance between the graphite contact landing right edge and the minimum x coordinate of the ReSe2/channel polygon.

verification_gates.name: graphite_pickup_not_blocked_by_top_hbn
verification_gates.requirement: The left metal pickup contact directly overlaps the graphite landing, and top hBN does not cover the graphite/contact overlap area.
verification_gates.method: Measure positive overlap between graphite and the left metal pickup/contact landing; verify the top-hBN region has zero intersection with that overlap or has a documented local opening/notch around it.

verification_gates.name: review_geometry_excluded
verification_gates.requirement: Annotation, legend, inset, scale-bar, and other review-only shapes are not drawn in GDS unless explicitly requested and are excluded from routing-rule extraction and geometry verification.
verification_gates.method: Check layer map and visual_legend actual_circuit_layer flags; verify geometry checks use only physical/electrical layers.

verification_gates.name: alignment_marker_present
verification_gates.requirement: Design includes or imports alignmarker2.GDS marker geometry on layer 1/0.
verification_gates.method: Check GDS layers and bbox/signature against profile.

verification_gates.name: bond_pad_size
verification_gates.requirement: The design directly reuses the 21 imported nominal-250 um pad-like landing regions from alignmarker2.GDS as routed bond pads and does not generate additional bond pads unless explicitly overridden.
verification_gates.method: Measure imported pad-like landing-region bboxes and check that routed nets terminate on those imported pads.

verification_gates.name: connectivity
verification_gates.requirement: Each required contact/gate net reaches exactly its intended pad unless a shared bus is specified.
verification_gates.method: KlayoutClaw route_inspect or pya.Region connectivity checks.

verification_gates.name: project_layer_grouping
verification_gates.requirement: Inner contacts/contact-net fan-out use one layer throughout the active inner routing zone, inner gate-net fan-out uses its assigned inner layer throughout that zone, device-family overhang rules are satisfied, and only geometry outside the inner zone transitions to the shared outer-contact layer.
verification_gates.method: Inspect result JSON layer map and GDS layer/datatype usage, and verify device-family overhang and inner-zone requirements when supplied.

verification_gates.name: inner_outer_handoff_boundary
verification_gates.requirement: The handoff from role-specific inner layers to the shared outer-contact layer occurs outside the fixed inner-zone rectangle, not at the active-core edge.
verification_gates.method: Check that contact/gate fan-out remains on the appropriate inner layer inside the active inner routing zone, then transitions to the shared outer-contact layer only outside that zone.

verification_gates.name: no_standalone_process_mask_layers
verification_gates.requirement: Clean-room session/process bookkeeping is metadata only; do not create standalone process mask layers such as 903/90 or 904/90 unless explicitly requested.
verification_gates.method: Inspect visual_legend/effective layer count and verify process-order-only layers are absent or marked non-effective when a fabrication mask deliverable was not requested.

verification_gates.name: bond_pad_touching_landing_width
verification_gates.requirement: Only the short outer-routing landing/neck segment directly touching or overlapping an imported bond pad is 50 um wide unless explicitly overridden; other outer-routing segments are not required to be 50 um. The pad-touching neck must extend at least 50 um into the pad, or twice the previous shallow depth, whichever is larger, and must have no missing corner, notch, chamfer, or diagonal bite.
verification_gates.method: Measure pya.Path widths or route polygon bboxes only for the pad-touching landing/neck segment, verify the pad-entry depth and complete orthogonal endpoint, and verify wider/narrower downstream outer-routing segments are allowed when clearance and connectivity checks pass.

verification_gates.name: display_style
verification_gates.requirement: Review display uses unfilled/transparent outline style, saturated pink/magenta imported align markers, orange contact metal, light-blue imported bond pads and outer routing metal, soft scientific-plot colors for other layers, and black/dark non-white annotation text.

verification_gates.name: no_unintended_shorts
verification_gates.requirement: No unintended same-layer shorts or mid-body route crossings.
verification_gates.method: KlayoutClaw evaluate_design when available, otherwise pya.Region intersection/isolation checks.

verification_gates.name: obstacle_clearance
verification_gates.requirement: Routes avoid active materials, gates, foreign flakes, and keep-out regions unless the approved device stack requires contact.
verification_gates.method: Spacing/separation checks against explicit obstacle layers.

verification_gates.name: result_traceability
verification_gates.requirement: Result JSON reports profile_version, routing layers, pad layer, contact layers, route method, checks run, and any deviations.
